notes: KNOB_CC=20, MASTER_CC=27 (web/emu/worklet.js). The page takes notes and CCs for the synth; encoders only reach the UI when 'knobs' is ticked (it maps CC 20..26 to knob roles by relative delta, abs/bin/twos/sign modes). Buttons reach the UI only through the page's own {type:'buttons'} channel, which this firmware cannot produce - use web/fm1-shim.js.
